extracted.name: Peach Salad
extracted.description: This is a classic Peach Salad, simple as it is supposed to be, intended to make the most of juicy sweet peaches when they are in season! It's a magical summer salad combination - sweet peaches, salty prosciutto, creamy buffalo mozzarella and the pepper rocket/arugula.Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature for the best eating experience.
ingredient_lines: 150g/5oz ball buffalo or cow’s milk mozzarella ((1 ball, ok it slightly less or more))
4 slices prosciutto ((or jamon serrano, about 70g/2.5 oz; for other subs see Note 1))
instruction_lines: Cut peach: Halve peaches. Remove seed. Cut each half into half again. If your peaches are really large, cut each half into thirds.
Dressing: Combined dressing ingredients in a jar and shake well.
Toss rocket in ~2 tbsp of dressing.
Assemble: Arrange rocket, peaches, mozzarella on a large plate or platter. Drape prosciutto around salad. Drizzle remaining oil over the salad. Serve!
